notes.title: Game update
notes.content:
A pretty large update has been started for Relentless Protagonist.  Besides update CGs (with some new ones as well), the story has been updated and various new graphics have been introduced as well.

I'm hoping this will be available in the first quarter of 2025

tags.feature: Besides update CGs (with some new ones as well), the story has been updated and various new graphics have been introduced as well.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Whilst I'm waiting for various things to do with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1981690/WTC__Loves_Labours_Lost/]WTC : Love's Labour's Lost[/url] I have started on updating WTC : Relentless Protagonist

So far the following has been implemented :

[list]
[*] New prologue/skip to chapter #1 graphics
[*] New options to skip some of the prologue (new achievements here)
[*] Dialogue has been modified to allow easy translation (which is probably will be)
[/list]

tags.feature: New prologue/skip to chapter #1 graphics
New options to skip some of the prologue (new achievements here)
Dialogue has been modified to allow easy translation (which is probably will be)

notes.title: Upcoming Update
notes.content:
The upcoming Relentless Protagonist will have the following updates :

[list]
[*] Dialogue with parents will now be gender specific
[*] Added a new small school section for Days 1 and 2
[*] New side story added
[*] Extra achievements added
[*[ A couple of new backgrounds
[*] Add extra sound effects in a couple of places
[*] New routes and story added for an ex-class representative 
[/list]

I hope to have this update out by the end of January 2023

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
This update removes a check for system locale which is a problem with some operating systems.

In addition, a new "Cheat" option has been added for those unable to buy "Recruitment Day".  Complete the game once, and go into Preferences.  In there will be a "Cheat" option, which will mark "Recruitment Day" and gain you the achievement.
